scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.scripts.seed
scripts.policy:index: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.scripts.index_policies
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check app tests alembic
scripts.eval:ai-review: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.evals.approval_review
scripts.eval:approval-draft: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.evals.approval_draft
scripts.eval:work-assistant: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.evals.work_assistant
scripts.eval:leave-assistant: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.evals.leave_assistant
scripts.eval:policy-rag: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.evals.policy_retrieval
scripts.eval:all: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.evals.suite --output ../../artifacts/evals/latest.json
scripts.smoke:deployment: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.ops.deployment_smoke
scripts.type-check:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy app tests
scripts.validate: pnpm check:pattern && pnpm eval:expense:offline && pnpm lint:api && pnpm type-check:api && pnpm test:api && pnpm lint:web && pnpm type-check:web && pnpm build:web
scripts.eval:expense:offline: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.evals.draft_contract
